name: Dazzling Lancer (Combat)
body:
Your lance blows can be devastating, leaving your foes reeling.

Prerequisite(s): Mounted Combat, Dazzling Display

Benefit(s): When making a mounted charge with a polearm, if you reduce your target to 0 or fewer hit points you may make an Intimidate Check as a free action against each enemy within 30 feet.
